audit_1800_note: the 2026-10-02T1800Z audit of the previous run (its AUDIT.md) sampled 20 units (u074, 15 READINGS, 4 LABELLED) and rejected four; its sample is stratified, so 16/20 is not a corpus rate

audit_1800_repairs.u035: Rejected 2026-10-02T1800Z (the duties covered each violating act but had no victim argument, so a remedy for one victim could satisfy the duty while another victim of the same act received none). Repaired: the regulated argument is a violation, one violation of one person's right by one act (its victim is its own), and the act phrase names the victim ('provide the victim of {1} with an effective remedy'). Pending a fresh independent audit.
audit_1800_repairs.u051: Rejected 2026-10-02T1800Z (the noninterference duties applied only to someone already seeking or enjoying asylum, leaving a person's opportunity to begin seeking it outside them). Repaired: the guard is the person's exposure to persecution, suffered or threatened (open term persecution), whether or not the person has begun to seek asylum; the liberty reading is unchanged. Pending a fresh independent audit.
audit_1800_repairs.u054: Rejected 2026-10-02T1800Z (the claim made the person obliged to receive a nationality; a right to a nationality does not oblige its holder to accept one). Repaired: the claim is a duty on whichever bearer owes the person a nationality, through the base relation owes_nationality_to (open term bearer_of_the_nationality_duty), so the duty never sits on the holder and no bearer is invented; the liberty reading is unchanged. Pending a fresh independent audit.
audit_1800_repairs.u111: Rejected 2026-10-02T1800Z (the readings obliged every person to be free of each deficient limitation, tied no limitation to the affected person or to a particular right, and put the obligation on the right holder). Repaired: the duty is on a bearer (a State, or any State, group or person) who must avoid imposing a limitation; a limitation is one limitation on one person's exercise of one right or freedom, so the affected person and the right are its own. A relation from a limitation to a rights line is still not expressible (limitation scope names rights, which are open sets here; S2). Eight candidates: two readings of 'and' between the aims, strict or defeasible, state or any bearer. Pending a fresh independent audit.

force of Articles 22-27: the default candidates of the entitlement units cite 'the organization and resources of each State' (Article 22) as the exception factor; VE has narrowings that would pick the default reading, and this run does not apply one (a translator keeping all readings), so strict and defeasible stay open

polarity budget: units that state an entitlement to a good or a protection (social security, conditions of work, protection against unemployment, a share in advancement) offer the securing duty only (the audit precedent: 'avoid denying X' is the same duty); the freedoms (work, free choice of employment, trade unions, education, participation, the arts) offer both polarities
